bio: Devised the Vijapure Type for Devanagari, patented in 1929, and a linear scheme for the Linotype. Monotype issued Vijapure Devanagari; he designed the Ganesh typeface in 1960.

sources.title: Typography of Devanagari, Volume Two, pp. 329–333, 407–409 (Bapurao S. Naik)
sources.publisher: Directorate of Languages, Government of Maharashtra

sources.title: Invisible hands: tracing the origins and development of the Devanagari Linotype - University of Reading
